column1: Purpose: Master inventory of potential risks that may affect MFS. This is a living inventory, not an annual risk rating or audit plan.

Important: Baseline entries are starting points. Validate applicability, wording, business functions, and proposed owner functions against the approved MFS Organizational Background before treating them as confirmed MFS risks.
